subject: [PATCH v5 04/19] selftests/mm: skip khugepaged page cache cases without a PMD folio

2026-09-08.patch_summary: This patch modifies the selftests/mm module to skip khugepaged page cache cases that do not support PMD folios. The issue arises from a limitation in the page cache, which caps folio order at MAX_PAGECACHE_ORDER, below the PMD order on certain architectures. As a result, the kernel refuses collapses for PMD-sized pages, leading to test failures. To address this, the patch introduces a new function thp_file_supported_orders() to determine supported orders and skips shmem and file mem types where the cap is below the PMD order. This ensures that tests are only run on architectures that support PMD folios.
